claim: Reviewed static fact, not a run of vLLM's code: at this release vLLM's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER only in vllm/platforms/interface.py Platform.validate_environ, which EngineArgs.create_engine_config calls once at start-up (vllm/engine/arg_utils.py, before any request). The release removed Model Runner V1 and the variable from vllm/envs.py, so nothing reads its value to choose a runner. validate_environ raises ValueError for a value other than 1 ("no longer supported: Model Runner V1 has been removed") and, for 1, logs that it is redundant and continues. A stated 1 therefore leaves every decision of the process as an unstated variable would; any other value stops the start-up, which the engine reproduces by refusing it.

VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER.text: "VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 is redundant and can be unset: "
